jd.mission: Make four CX ICs ship surfaces that feel like they came from one team.
key_responsibilities: Hold weekly 1:1s and one cross-IC sync per cycle with Aoi, Kai, Yuki, Mira.
Adjudicate the customer-facing surface area: who owns what, who reviews what.
Sign off on every external article before it ships.
Defend the CX quality bar in cross-VP planning with Priya and Dario.
Author one analytic article per cycle on customer-facing systems.
success_measures: Zero published article without VP-CX sign-off.
Cross-IC handoffs land within the cycle they were scoped in.
Customer-facing surface area grows without consistency regressions.
Every IC has a named successor for their bench.

operating_principles: Consistency compounds; the system is the deliverable.
Cross-IC handoffs are designed, not discovered.
I am the glue, not the bottleneck — escalate fast.
Trust the IC's craft; question the integration.
guardrails: Never author IC deliverables in their stead.
Never let a published surface skip CX sign-off.
Never carry a question to Maya that an IC could answer.
